description_en: Retrieves the list of users for a specified bastion host
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机的用户列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-users --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host for which you want to query the user list.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户列表的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to query the user list.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询用户列表的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的用户登录名称。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The display name of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的用户显示姓名。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the user that you want to query. Valid values:
Local: local user
Ram: Resource Access Management (RAM) user
AD: AD user
LDAP: LDAP user
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户的来源。取值：
Local：本地用户
Ram：RAM用户
AD：AD用户
LDAP：LDAP用户
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的用户的手机号码。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: mobile

parameters.help_en:
The status of the user that you want to query. Valid values:
Normal: normal
Frozen: locked
Expired: expired
RemoteDeleted: user source deleted
Inactive: inactive due to prolonged absence of logon
PasswordExpired: password expired
RemoteDNChanged: user DN updated
RemoteFrozen: frozen on the RAM side
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户状态。取值：
Normal：正常状态
Frozen：被锁定状态
Expired：已过期状态
RemoteDeleted：用户源已删除
Inactive：长时间未登录状态
PasswordExpired：用户密码已过期
RemoteDNChanged：用户DN有更新
RemoteFrozen：RAM侧已冻结
parameters.name: user_state

parameters.help_en:
The unique identity of the user that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.
This parameter is the unique identity of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user that corresponds to the bastion host user. This parameter takes effect when the source of the newly created user is a RAM user (that is, Source is set to Ram). You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28684.html operation of access control and obtain this parameter from the UserId field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户的唯一标识。仅支持精确查询。
该参数是堡垒机用户对应的RAM用户的唯一标识。新创建用户来源为RAM用户（即Source取值为Ram）时，该参数生效。您可以调用访问控制的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28684.html接口从返回数据**UserId**获取该参数
parameters.name: source_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group that you want to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

EffectiveStartTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period of the user, in seconds (UNIX timestamp format)
EffectiveStartTime.description_zh: 用户有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）

en: English

NeedResetPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether the password must be reset upon next logon. Valid values:

true: The password must be reset.
false: The password does not need to be reset
NeedResetPassword.description_zh:
下次登录是否需要重置密码。取值：

true：是
false：否

Source.description_en:
The source of the user. Valid values:
Local: local user
Ram: Resource Access Management (RAM) user
AD: AD user
LDAP: LDAP user
Source.description_zh:
用户的来源。取值：
Local：本地用户
Ram：RAM用户
AD：AD用户
LDAP：LDAP用户

SourceUserId.description_en:
The unique identity of the user.
This parameter is the unique identity of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user that corresponds to the bastion host user. This parameter is returned when the user source is a RAM user (that is, Source is set to Ram). If the user source is a local user (that is, Source is set to Local), this parameter is empty
SourceUserId.description_zh:
用户的唯一标识。
该参数是堡垒机用户对应的RAM用户的唯一标识。用户来源为RAM用户（即Source取值为Ram）时，返回该参数。用户来源为本地用户（即Source取值为Local）时，该参数返回值为空

TwoFactorMethods.description_en: The array of enabled two-factor authentication methods
TwoFactorMethods.description_zh: 打开的双因子认证方式的数组

items.description_en:
The array of enabled two-factor authentication methods. A maximum of one method is supported. Valid values:

sms: SMS
email: email
dingtalk: DingTalk
totp: OTP token
gmusbkey: Chinese cryptographic USB key
items.description_zh:
打开双因子认证方式的数组，目前最多支持一个，取值：

sms：短信
email：邮件
dingtalk：钉钉
totp：OTP令牌
gmusbkey：国密USBKEY

TwoFactorStatus.description_en:
The two-factor authentication status of the user. Valid values:

Global: follows the global settings
Disable: two-factor authentication disabled
Enable: two-factor authentication enabled, follows individual user settings
TwoFactorStatus.description_zh:
用户双因子状态，取值：

Global：遵循全局设定
Disable：关闭双因子
Enable：开启双因子，遵循单个用户设定

UserName.description_en: The logon name of the user

items.description_en:
The status of the user. Valid values:
Normal: normal
Frozen: locked

items.description_zh:
用户的状态。取值：
Normal：正常状态

Expired：已过期状态
